goal: 5-10 technically qualifying EXTREME candidates from N48; stop at 10 accepted or when the budget below is spent; never pad. Technically qualified is NOT human-approved.
cores: 24 existing cores in 6 families (cores.json; seed_<key>.json are copies of the earlier seeds; where max_solve_nodes was missing it is set to 600 - the Category A TIME UP gate stays the judge)

search_budget.order: round 1 = every core with seed 13 (6 waves of 4, families interleaved); stage 2 on its results; round 2 (seed 14) only if fewer than 10 boards were accepted

stage2_candidates: per run: up to 2 qualifying clusters (boards differing in <= 3 cells form one cluster), the top-scoring board of each; then dropped before any report if its occupancy overlap (the Phase 19/20 measure, best of 8 symmetries) is >= 0.40 with any bank board (N1-N38) or a candidate already accepted, or if an earlier-ranked candidate from the same core is already accepted
report_budget: at most 40 full reports (tools/ta90_design.gd, one at a time on an otherwise idle machine, after the round's searches); reports go round-robin across families, best search score first within a family
acceptance (all must hold): ta90_design.gd verdict HUMAN-REVIEW CANDIDATE for target EXTREME (Category A and B, thresholds unchanged: parity 0/0, deterministic replay, solve <= 40 ms, TIME UP check <= 40 ms from every position; distinct >= 4, steps >= 8, endgame decision, coverage >= 0.60, late >= 0.75, solution >= 13, greedy shortcut <= 0.20, every listed mechanic matters, no near copy)
every listed mechanic ESSENTIAL, not marginal: without it the board is unsolvable, or loses >= 2 distinct mistakes, or >= 3 decision steps (Phase 20's judgement made a rule)
not a variant: overlap < 0.40 with every bank board and every accepted Phase 21 board; at most 1 accepted board per core
diversity cap: at most 3 accepted boards per family
exact TIME UP continuation incl. UNDO right after continuing (Ta90ContinueCheck --boards)
browser: WebAssembly TIME UP check within the page test's limit, iPhone SE layout
never: change a threshold after seeing results
methodology: Phase 21 protocol unchanged (data/dev/extreme90_p21/protocol.json): the same 24 cores (copied seed files), the same generator (ta90_search.gd --ops=v20), budget, stage-2 procedure, report budget and acceptance rules. Only the RNG seeds change (13 / 14 instead of 11 / 12). The similarity reference now includes N39-N47 (every board record in data/dev).
